mapper.sql: select r.sale_id, r.dept_id, r.period_id, r.sale_no, r.product_id, r.member_id, r.member_no, r.member_name, coalesce(nullif(r.product_name, ''), fp.product_name) as product_name, r.sale_quantity, r.gift_quantity, r.total_quantity, r.sale_amount, r.unit_price, r.paid_amount, r.sale_date, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.period_no as period_no, p.status as period_status from fin_sale_record r left join fin_accounting_period p on r.period_id = p.period_id left join fin_product fp on fp.product_id = r.product_id and fp.dept_id = r.dept_id
mapper.select: where r.sale_id = #{saleId}
where r.sale_id = #{saleId} for update
where r.sale_no = #{saleNo} and r.del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(*) from fin_sale_record date(create_time) = curdate() and del_flag = '0'
select ifnull(max(cast(substring(sale_no, -4) as unsigned)), 0) from fin_sale_record where sale_no like concat('SX', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
mapper.insert:
insert into fin_sale_record
dept_id, period_id, sale_no, product_id, member_id, member_no, member_name, product_name, sale_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, sale_amount, unit_price, paid_amount, sale_date, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{deptId}, #{periodId}, #{saleNo}, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{productName}, #{saleQuantity}, #{giftQuantity}, #{totalQuantity}, #{saleAmount}, #{unitPrice}, #{paidAmount}, #{saleDate}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark},
mapper.update: update fin_sale_record set paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where sale_id = #{saleId}
mapper.delete: update fin_sale_record set del_flag = '2' where sale_id = #{saleId}

mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(r.sale_amount - coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0)), 0) from fin_sale_record r where r.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0) < r.sale_amount
and r.dept_id in #{deptId}

select count(*) from fin_sale_record r where r.del_flag = '0' and coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0) < r.sale_amount and datediff(curdate(), date(r.sale_date)) > 30
and r.dept_id in #{deptId}
